FIELDS.NAME: Pawsitive Care Veterinary Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Pawsitive Care Veterinary Services, we specialize in providing comprehensive veterinary care for companion animals, including routine medical examinations, vaccinations, diagnostics, and minor surgical procedures. Our facility is designed to ensure the safety and well-being of our patients, adhering to strict animal welfare standards. We offer ancillary services such as grooming and training, which are carefully managed to minimize any risks associated with our primary veterinary operations. Our dedicated team consists solely of licensed veterinarians and credentialed veterinary technicians, ensuring that all medical procedures are performed with the highest standard of care. We maintain a clean and secure facility, equipped with well-maintained diagnostic and surgical equipment, and follow documented waste handling protocols to comply with health and safety regulations. Additionally, we do not provide large-scale or long-term boarding services, further enhancing our focus on delivering quality veterinary care in a safe environment.
